# Songbird OoT 12-hole, Alto C and Tenor A: measured numbers (generated by measure_songbird.py)

Measured on the Alto C cut-out (longest chord of the body 1196 px). The maker gives no size for the Alto C: millimetres are for an **estimated** length of 170 mm (the evidence allows 152–181 mm). The Tenor A column takes the maker's 203.2 mm and **assumes the same design scaled up** (× 1.195). s = station along the body axis, 0 at the bulb end, 1 at the tail tip. Across is + toward the player.
